madagascar|scientist.answer: In October 2026, Madagascar recorded 5612 MODIS-equivalent fire-days, which is far below the typical value of 7760 fire-days for a baseline period of 2003–2022. This total placed October at the 5th percentile, with a 90% range of 5464 to 5739 and a ratio to typical of 0.7. For November 2026 (days 1–8 only, compared with the same days of baseline years), the region recorded 1723 fire-days against a typical value of 1800 fire-days, sitting at the 38th–48th percentile with a 90% range of 1625 to 1807 and a ratio to typical of 1. All numbers are MODIS-equivalent fire-days on the old satellite's scale. Method: see the Proof page.
